conviction_note: CHRN does not report on 2026-08-31: it has a 31 May fiscal year end and already filed its FY2026 10-K on 2026-08-19 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1549084/000162828026058018/chrn-20260531.htm), so 2026-08-31 is the END of its fiscal Q1 2027, whose 10-Q falls due in October - and separately the sealed baseline's seven-print reaction history belongs to Ekso Bionics Holdings, the predecessor on the same CIK, not to this business at all.
searched_and_found_nothing: Whether an earnings event exists on 2026-08-31 at all. It does not. EDGAR CIK 0001549084 shows the FY2026 annual report (fiscal year ended 2026-05-31) filed 2026-08-19, and no Item 2.02 8-K by ChronoScale at any point since the merger closed: https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001549084.json . The company's own IR results page lists nothing scheduled and no release since 2025-10-28: https://ir.chronoscale.com/financials-filings/financial-results . MarketBeat lists no upcoming date and mislabels the 2026-08-19 10-K as 'Q2 2026', i.e. it is still applying the legacy 31-December Ekso calendar: https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/CHRN/earnings/ . EDGAR's own company metadata still carries fiscalYearEnd 1231, which is the mechanism by which a vendor calendar manufactures a spurious 2026-08-31 row from a fiscal-quarter end.

Validity of the sealed baseline's reaction history. All seven events (2024-10-28 through 2026-02-17) predate the 2026-05-05 reverse merger and are prints by EKSO BIONICS HOLDINGS, INC., which held this CIK from 2014-01-23 to 2026-05-05 per formerNames in https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001549084.json . The 2026-02-17 Item 2.02 8-K is literally filed as ekso20260216_8k.htm. The share base was reconstituted on 2026-05-05 when 138,216,820 new shares were issued to Applied Digital, so the pre-merger move distribution describes a different company, a different capital structure and a different investor base. deadband_pct 4.88 and expected_move_pct 9.76 are therefore not usable as a statement of what this stock does around a print.

Whether the float could even support a tradable reaction. It barely can. The 10-K reports 145,637,452 shares outstanding at 2026-08-18 while Applied Digital and its subsidiary hold ~96% (8-K of 2026-06-26, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1549084/000149315226030318/form8-k.htm), leaving roughly 5.8m shares public against the baseline's 171,200 average daily volume - which is also why the option chain in the baseline was unpriceable. This is a controlled-company stub, not a name with a priced-in expectation to trade against.

The obvious catalysts, all of which are already in the tape and none of which is an 31 August event: the Microsoft 50MW deployment whose term was extended from two years to three, announced 2026-08-27 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001549084/000149315226039008/form8-k.htm is the 08-18 filing; the Microsoft item is https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001549084/000149315226040398/form8-k.htm); the $100m related-party Demand Grid Note from Applied Digital signed 2026-06-26 with $7.0m drawn 2026-07-01; the 2026-06-04 Item 2.05 commitment to divest Ekso Bionics (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1549084/000149315226027271/form8-k.htm); and the 1,097,509-share resale shelf that went effective 2026-07-15 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1549084/000149315226032840/forms-3a.htm), about 19% of the public float. Each is dated, disclosed and in the price.

Aggregator fundamentals for CHRN, which are contaminated in the same way as the baseline. Simply Wall St and similar carry FY2026 revenue of $12.8m and net loss of $11.7m for 'ChronoScale Holdings'; those are the legacy Ekso exoskeleton numbers for the discontinued, held-for-sale business (https://www.pressdemocrat.com/2026/08/27/ekso-bionics-marin-chronoscale-reverse-merger/, 2026-08-27), against consolidated fiscal-2026 net losses of $50.3m in the actual 10-K. Any consensus line for this ticker is describing a company that is being sold off.

Single-customer risk as a possible unpriced item. It is disclosed in plain text on the face of the 10-K filed 2026-08-19: at 2026-05-31 the Cloud business had exactly one customer, Together AI, on ~6,144 H100s across ~14MW in Colorado, Minnesota and Utah, on a twelve-month term from 2026-03-01 that then auto-renews in sixty-day increments. Disclosed eleven days ago in the annual report is priced.

Hiring-page, changelog, status-page and customer-forum angles. The operating entity sells dedicated GPU capacity to a single wholesale counterparty, so it has no public product surface, no app-store presence, no support forum and no retail customer base to read - there is no alt-data channel here to be early on.
baseline_tension: The question does not arise: the run-up cannot cut for or against a finding because the event the baseline is built around does not exist on 2026-08-31, and the -21.4% five-day move it records is a thin 4%-float stub reacting to an AI-complex derate and to the 2026-08-27 Microsoft announcement, not a drift into a print.
